import pandas as pd
from collections import defaultdict

# Create a dictionary to store the total number of channel messages for each user
user_messages = defaultdict(int)

# List of all channel messages
all_channel_messages = [
    {"body": "Secret key is 1a7b3d.", "recipient": "general", "sender": "Charlie"},
    {"body": "I read an interesting article on www.informations.com!", "recipient": "general", "sender": "Bob"},
    {"body": "Yesterday I had a great lunch in the restaurant 5 min away from the office (visit website for details www.restaurant-zurich.com).", "recipient": "general", "sender": "Eve"},
    {"body": "Has anyone seen my coffee mug?", "recipient": "random", "sender": "Alice"},
    {"body": "just testing", "recipient": "private", "sender": "Charlie"}
]

# Count the total number of channel messages for each user
for message in all_channel_messages:
    user_messages[message["sender"]] += 1

# Sort users by total number of channel messages and then by name
sorted_users = sorted(user_messages.items(), key=lambda x: (-x[1], x[0]))

# Send a direct message to each user with their rank
for i, (user, count) in enumerate(sorted_users):
    print(f"Sending message to {user}: Congrats on being the {i+1}-th most active user!")
